Class GameStateDTO

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.dto.GameStateDTO
public class GameStateDTO extends Object
Serializable snapshot of the public game state for network transport.

  • Constructor Details

    • GameStateDTO

      public GameStateDTO(String gameId, Age age, int turn, int currentTileIndex, int extraIndex, String currentPhaseName, List<GameStateDTO.PlayerDTO> players, GameStateDTO.BoardDTO board, List<Totem> turnOrder, List<Totem> orderTileOrder, Totem activePlayer, int deckSize, int remainingUpperPicks, int remainingBottomPicks)
      Full constructor used by Jackson deserialization.
      Parameters:
      gameId - the game identifier
      age - the current age
      turn - the current turn number
      currentTileIndex - the tile scan index
      extraIndex - the extra-pick scan index
      currentPhaseName - the simple name of the current phase
      players - the player snapshots
      board - the board snapshot
      turnOrder - the totems in turn order
      orderTileOrder - the totems in order-tile order
      activePlayer - the totem of the player currently expected to act
      deckSize - the remaining cards in the current age deck
      remainingUpperPicks - the active player's remaining top-row picks
      remainingBottomPicks - the active player's remaining bottom-row picks
